newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle higher before long weekend.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle higher before long weekend.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled higher ahead of a long holiday weekend, but the overall outlook remains negative for prices, market sources said.
Benchmark September settled 0.85 cent higher at 77.45 cents a lb after trading from 77.50 to 76.45 cents. The rest finished 0.20 lower to 1.05 cents higher.
Support for most-active September remained at 74.05 cents, followed by 72.00 cents. Resistance was pegged at 78.00 cents.
An estimated 2,500 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Wednesday's official 2,256 lots.
Total open interest fell by 25 lots to stand at 31,634 lots as of Wednesday, but analysts fear the still high liquidity positions the market for a sharp selloff.

Demand, meantime, remains flat. The Florida Citrus Processors' Association said weekly movement reached 4.673 million gallons for the week ended June 28, compared with 4.799 gallons the previous week.
NYCE will be closed Friday for Independence Day.
